title: WHY AI MODELS GET DUMBER - engraving-plate sample (v3)

beats.vo: Ever get the feeling your AI is a little duller than it used to be?
You ask it something simple, and what comes back is thinner. Vaguer. Mush.
beats.say: You ask it something simple, | and what comes back is thinner. | Vaguer. | Mush.

beats.vo: You are not imagining it. There is a paper in Nature about exactly this, and the mechanism is strange.
beats.say: You are not imagining it. || There is a paper in Nature about exactly this, | and the mechanism is strange.

beats.vo: To learn anything at all, a model has to eat the internet. Every page, every post, every review.
beats.say: To learn anything at all, a model has to eat the internet. || Every page, every post, every review.

beats.vo: But the internet is not written only by people any more.
Machines write an enormous share of it now. Product descriptions, reviews, summaries, answers.
beats.say: Machines write an enormous share of it now. || Product descriptions, reviews, summaries, answers.

beats.vo: So the next model learns from pages the last model wrote.
A machine writes it. The web keeps it. The next machine drinks it straight back in.
beats.say: A machine writes it. | The web keeps it. | The next machine drinks it straight back in.

beats.vo: Scientists have a name for what that does. Model collapse. A system eating its own tail.
beats.say: Scientists have a name for what that does. || Model collapse. || A system eating its own tail.

beats.vo: In twenty twenty-four, researchers sealed the loop on purpose, and watched what happened.
beats.say: In twenty twenty four, researchers sealed the loop on purpose, | and watched what happened.

beats.vo: They trained a model on its own output. Then trained the next one on that. Again, and again.
beats.say: They trained a model on its own output. | Then trained the next one on that. | Again, and again.

beats.vo: By the ninth generation, a small model given a passage about English church towers was writing about jackrabbit tail colours.
beats.say: By the ninth generation, | a small model given a passage about English church towers | was writing about jackrabbit tail colours.

hero.plate: after the experiment in nature, shumailov et al. 2024

beats.vo: The rare things went first. The odd fact, the unusual word, the one in a thousand case.
beats.say: The rare things went first. || The odd fact, the unusual word, the one in a thousand case.

beats.vo: What survives is the middle. The average, of the average, of the average.
beats.say: What survives is the middle. || The average, | of the average, | of the average.

beats.vo: This is not a bug anybody can patch. It is what happens when a copy becomes the source.
beats.say: This is not a bug anybody can patch. || It is what happens when a copy becomes the source.

beats.vo: No hack. No villain. Nobody has to do a single thing wrong.
beats.say: No hack. | No villain. | Nobody has to do a single thing wrong.

beats.vo: The machine just drinks its own output, and nobody is watching the well.
And this is already inside the tools you use every day.
It will not arrive as an error. It arrives as an answer that is slightly, confidently wrong.
beats.say: It will not arrive as an error. || It arrives as an answer that is slightly, | confidently wrong.

beats.vo: Which is the kind of wrong nobody catches.
There are fixes. Keep human writing. Label what the machines made. Pay for the real thing.
beats.say: There are fixes. || Keep human writing. | Label what the machines made. | Pay for the real thing.

beats.vo: Every one of those costs money. The loop costs nothing.
beats.say: Every one of those costs money. || The loop costs nothing.

beats.vo: So the next time your AI feels a little duller, you know what it has been eating.
beats.say: So the next time your AI feels a little duller | - you know what it has been eating.
